name: Robinson: Gränslandet
description: Contestants voted out from "Robinson", the Swedish version of Survivor, receive a chance to return to the main competition by surviving the harsh conditions of the borderland.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Season premiere. A well-known Robinson profile is deserted on an island with nothing but a volleyball as his companion. But he will soon be joined by another inhabitant, eagerly hoping to win a ticket back to the Robinson contest.
